programme.title: I Believe
programme.desc: Chu Chu waits 10 years for her first love, who marries another. Losing faith, she meets a wedding planner and a wealthy man, both offering solace. Torn between them, who will she choose in the end?

programme.title: Dragon Tiger Gate
programme.desc: Tiger Wong is ambushed after taking the Lousha Plaque, but is saved by his brother and also befriends Turbo Shek. To avenge the death of Dragon Gate masters, the trio vow to defeat Lousha Clan leader.

programme.title: Remember What I Forgot
programme.desc: Kim is suffering from Alzheimer's disease but Ginger suspects that he is a film critic profiting from harsh reviews. Posing as a friend, Ginger gets closer to him and uncovers his secrets and sorrows.

programme.title: Detective Vs. Sleuths
programme.desc: Hong Kong is rocked by a series of cold-blooded murders whose victims are runaway suspects of unsolved cases. The group of killers calls themselves The Chosen Sleuths.

programme.title: 72 Tenants of Prosperity
programme.desc: Two sworn brothers become enemies after the girl they love marries one of them. The rivalry is only resolved when the property owner of their shops wants to terminate their tenancies 40 years later.

programme.title: Mad Fate
programme.desc: A fortune teller predicts that Tung will be imprisoned for murder, he tries to change his fate but a veteran detective believes Tung to be a psychopathic serial killer & pursues him relentlessly.

programme.title: Queen of Mahjong
programme.desc: This Chinese New Year comedy follows three young couples navigating love, laughter, and long-held family secrets—with plenty of drama both around and on the mahjong table.

programme.title: The Grey Men
programme.desc: Undercover police officer Shan gains the trust of criminal Tian while gathering evidence against his gang. As Shan successfully destroys Tian's gang, he uncovers a shocking secret about Tian...

programme.title: Don't Forget I Love You
programme.desc: Lu Yao has amnesia & wakes up every day remembering nothing from the day before. He meets psychotherapist Xing Yue & they fall in love despite knowing they have no future together.

programme.title: Chinese Odyssey Part I - A Pandora's box
programme.desc: Chinese Odyssey Part I - A Pandora's box.

programme.title: The Way We Keep Dancing
programme.desc: This sequel features the plight of Hong Kong's grassroots performing artists fighting against the government's plan to gentrify an industrial district where they lived.

programme.title: Ride On
programme.desc: Master Luo, a retired stuntman, trains his beloved horse Red Hare to be a stunt horse. But due to his debts, he might lose his horse, so he seeks help from his estranged daughter & her boyfriend.

programme.title: YUM Investigation
programme.desc: A team of investigators was sent to an old building believed to be haunted by evil spirits, only to discover an unexpected secret concerning the future of the structure.

programme.title: I'm Livin' it
programme.desc: Once a successful banker, Bowen now spends his nights in a 24-hour fast food joint with a group of homeless people, with a plan to get themselves out of rock bottom.

programme.title: P Storm
programme.desc: Ping reports a case of prison corruption to the ICAC. ICAC officer Luk goes undercover in prison to investigate and is determined to complete his mission with the help of his cell mate, Wang.

programme.title: In Broad Daylight
programme.desc: Based on a true event of a news investigative unit receiving a tip-off about abuse in a care home for elderly and disabled. Reporter Kay goes undercover to unveil the cruel truth in broad daylight.

programme.title: Sons of the Neon Night
programme.desc: In snowy, surreal Hong Kong, an explosion kills a secret drug lord tycoon. As chaos erupts, his youngest son fights his fugitive brother and warring factions to destroy the family's criminal empire.

programme.title: The Rescue
programme.desc: An accident at an offshore drilling platform results in the call for the Transportation Emergency Response Team to save the survivors before the site collapses.

programme.title: Everything Under Control
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, Jelly steals the loot and flees, with his other cohorts hot on his heel. They stumble onto a remote village with strange villagers and mysterious eerie occurrences.

programme.title: Born to Fly
programme.desc: Headed by elite pilots, a special operations team is tasked to test new fighter jets. During test flights, the pilots face different difficulties and challenges, and try to push beyond their limits.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Caught in an underground fight to pay off debts, talented boxer Jia Yang loses her Olympics dream and quits boxing. A decade later, Coach Li aids her comeback. Can Jia Yang resurrect her boxing dream?

programme.title: Better Days
programme.desc: A high school student befriends a street punk as she copes with college entrance exam pressure and ruthless bullying. A murder investigation is set to alter both their lives.

programme.title: Flying Swords of Dragon Gate
programme.desc: Set three years after Dragon Inn, this sequel depicts a new inn that has risen from the ashes - one staffed by treasure seekers in disguise.

programme.title: Look for a Star
programme.desc: When a thrice-divorced entrepreneur falls for a poker dealer, who is also a cabaret dancer, they seem hopelessly mismatched - but will fate help them out?

programme.title: The Monkey King 3
programme.desc: The Queen of Female Kingdom falls in love with Monk Tang, but her advisor orders Monk Tang and his disciples to be killed. As the River Spirit appears, the kingdom is plunged into crisis!

programme.title: Flashover
programme.desc: Based on a true story, an earthquake causes the gas pipes in an industrial park to break, resulting in explosions & fires in the area. Firefighters must fight to safeguard lives, including their own.

programme.title: Vanguard
programme.desc: Vanguard, a covert private security, is tasked with protecting an accountant targeted by deadly mercenaries. In the process, they also discover another dangerous conspiracy.

programme.title: Look Up
programme.desc: Celebrating the 25th anniversary of HK's Handover with an anthology of 4 stories about an autistic young man, a reconciliation, a Chinese opera star & a Nepali youth.

programme.title: OMG! Mom's Big News
programme.desc: A mother in her 50s unexpectedly becomes pregnant, turning her family's quiet life upside down. As they prepare for the baby's arrival, chaos and laughter follow, teaching them love and acceptance.

programme.title: Punish Evil
programme.desc: Detective Chang investigates a currency heist, taking down one robber as the others plan a gold‑factory raid. With precise strategy, he stops their plot and brings them to justice.

programme.title: Band Four
programme.desc: An aspiring singer reunites with her estranged guitarist father, and along with other family members, they unite to support each other through their love for music.

programme.title: The Hedgehog
programme.desc: Wang's odd behavior and quirky ideas make him a social outcast. When he meets his teenage nephew who is ashamed of his stutter, the two develop a special friendship through mutual understanding.

programme.title: The Bride With White Hair
programme.desc: Based on the 1954 martial arts novel, this film details the tragic romance between wild swordsman Zhuo Yi-hang and rival cult assassin Lien Ni-chang, with a dark, erotic and visually stunning twist.

programme.title: Someday or One Day
programme.desc: Adapted from a TV series, the movie follows Huang as she mourns for her boyfriend's death and receives a mysterious cassette player to travel back in time. Will she be able to change his destiny?

programme.title: I Want to Be Rich
programme.desc: Born into poverty, Wah goes astray but has a kind heart. After meeting and falling in love with a Vietnamese woman Mei, he decides to rebuild his life and finally achieves his dream of wealth.

programme.title: Omniscient Reader: the Prophecy
programme.desc: Dok-ja is the only reader of an obscure web novel for 10 years. Suddenly, the apocalyptic world of the novel becomes reality. He and the novel's omnipotent hero strive to save the world.

programme.title: Citizen of a Kind
programme.desc: Duk-hee receives a call from a bank offering a loan. After sending money for fees, she realizes that was a scam. She receives another call one day. This time, it's a plea for help...

programme.title: Train to Busan
programme.desc: While a zombie-virus breaks out in South Korea, passengers including a father and young daughter, a couple, and several students struggle to survive on the train from Seoul to Busan.

programme.title: Steel Rain: Summit
programme.desc: A peace summit for Korea is derailed when the leaders of South Korea, North Korea and the U.S. are abducted by North Korean hardliners and held hostage in a submarine.

programme.title: Spring Garden
programme.desc: So-hee moves to a house in the rural area which is an inheritance from her husband. Later, she has an eerie feeling and believes the house has something to do with her husband's death.

programme.title: Amazon Bullseye
programme.desc: Jin-bong is a former archery medalist and forced to be an archery coach for his company's hidden motives. He meets 3 bowmen in the Amazon Rainforest and embarks on an adventure with them.

programme.title: Rebound
programme.desc: A rookie basketball coach lead 6 'no-body' players for straight matches in 8 days and turn the impossible possible.

programme.title: My Daughter Is A Zombie
programme.desc: Jung-hwan's daughter, Soo-ah, is infected with a zombie virus. He notices that she still seems to understand words, so he draws on his experience with animal training to guide his zombie daughter.

programme.title: Emergency Declaration
programme.desc: Mysterious deaths on plane forced the pilot to call for an unconditional emergency landing.

programme.title: The Unfair
programme.desc: A protest against urban renewal leads to death of a cop and a teen. The boy's father was arrested for the cop's death. A young attorney is assigned to defend the father.

programme.title: I (2021)
programme.desc: Ah-Young who grew up in an orphanage becomes the babysitter of Young-Chae, who is raising a 6-month-old child on her own. One day, her child has an accident and she places all the blame on Ah-Young...

programme.title: Berita Jam 5 petang-Nasionalfm, Angkasapuri Kuala Lumpur
RANCANGAN KATA DIRIK
programme.desc: Rancangan Kata Dirik menggunakan format berkomunikasi dalam Bahasa BIdayuh Salako. Racangan ini melibatkan dua orang tetamu jemputan dari kaum Salako yang berpengalaman dan mempunyai banyak pengetahuan mengenai budaya dan adat resam masyarakat Bidayuh Salako. Penggunaan muzik tradisional Salako (Wek Jonggan) pada permulaan dan pengakhiran rancangan. Disiarkan setiap hari Khamis jam 8 malam dalam Segmen Nganchang Putue. Siaran pertama ialah pada minggu pertama dan ketiga manakala siaran ulangan pada minggu kedua dan keempat. Durasi rancangan ialah 30 minit.
